notes.title: The Road Ahead. (Early Access Roadmap)
notes.notes:
The purpose of this road map is to show what features we are planning to implement until the release of the game. 
Also, we hope to get enough feedback and ideas from you to make the game better and more enjoyable!
[list]
[*]In game tutorial.
[*]Steam cloud.
[*]Allow the player to spend the collected coins on upgrades
[*]Add more sound to the game.
[*]Add music to the game.
[*]Blocking and parry mechanics.
[*]Fix projectiles for mobs.
[*]Implement the story mode.
[*]Allow the player to use a bow.
[*]Add extra content.
[*]Steam achievements.
[*]Make game bosses to have scripted combat.
[*]Steam Leaderboard.
[*]Oculus Rift support
[*]Allow players to set items and monsters on fire
[*]Allow players to mark locations.
[/list]

Please feel free to discuss the features that we presented in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/611970/discussions/2/]Suggestions[/url] sub forum.

notes.title: Patch s1.0.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Hello,

TimeToDie has been updated with some minor gameplay changes and bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally made items ungrabbable.
[*]Fixed an issue that made the game crash occasionally
[*]Fixed hand UI to correctly display remaining play time.
[*]Fixed an issue that made mobs were running through the player.
[/list]
